snippet.title: The Serpent & The Seed 🐍🌱 Official Launch Trailer (iOS & Android)
snippet.description:
The Serpent & The Seed is a poetic musical mobile adventure game, free to download on iOS and Android. In a world ruled by a serpent, his thorns & thistles have overcome. The only hope for defeating him lies hidden in an old, mostly forgotten book.

From Discipleship Tech, creators of the award-winning PrayerMate app. Songs & Music by Poor Bishop Hooper @PoorBishopHooper (https://www.poorbishophooper.com). Snake game music by Jim Guthrie @JimGuthriemusic (of Superbrothers: Sword & Sworcery EP fame)

📱 iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-serpent-and-the-seed/id1551967592 
🤖 Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=tech.discipleship.SerpentSeedGame
▶️ Find out more: https://discipleship.tech/serpentseedgame

Follow us on social media for updates:
▶️ Instagram: https://instagram.com/serpentseedgame
▶️ Facebook: https://facebook.com/serpentseedgame
▶️ TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@serpentseedgame
▶️ X: https://x.com/serpentseedgame

#indiegame #mobilegame #trailertuesday
